items.desc_now: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中，让各自保留历史的独立会话分工、交叉复核，并在批准的范围内共享上下文。
DeepSeek Harness 热键管理面板：查看并修改 DSH 快捷键，扫描系统与第三方来源，并可将窗口最小化到 Windows 通知区域。
items.desc_prev: Hotkey manager panel for DeepSeek Harness: browse and edit DSH shortcuts, scan system and third-party sources, and minimize the window to the Windows notification area.

items.desc_now: A DeepSeek Harness plugin: DeepSeek halves its rates off-peak. A small indicator icon in the composer shows which rate is live, plus your balance and today's spend.
items.desc_prev: A DeepSeek Harness plugin: DeepSeek halves its rates off-peak. A small sun or moon in the composer shows which rate is live, plus your balance and today's spend.
